title: Neuroplasticity Gyms Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Neuroplasticity Gyms operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Neuroplasticity Gyms installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 12601 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where training rigs monitoring, gym logistics redundancy, or plasticity protocols maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Neuroplasticity Gyms Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Neuroplasticity Gyms: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Neuroplasticity Gyms — gyms training the brain like a muscle.

Phase 1 — Prove (training rigs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (gym logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (plasticity protocols): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (progress tracking): gym hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and brain health-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
